profile.headline: Lead Principal Software Engineer at Freedom Consulting Group, LLC
profile.summary: Experienced Full Stack Senior Software Engineer with more than 20 years of experience with design, development, and analysis in both agile and waterfall methodologies.

positions.description: Skills: Serverless Framework · Kubernetes · Continuous Integration (CI) · NoSQL · Network Load Balancing · TypeScript · NestJS · Spring Boot · Git · JavaScript · AWS Command Line Interface (CLI) · Microservices

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software development for several web-based applications using Java, Spring, and EXT JS for use within the Ozone Widget Framework.  Tasks Include:

• Developed an Error Management Tool (EMT) application to allow clients to fix data ingest errors         occurring in a GOTS data flow tool (Niagara Files) and resubmit encrypted data back to the ingestion processes.
•Developed enhancements for Error Management tool to use a Watcher service for performance improvements.
•Developed an Ingest Configuration application that allowed clients to interact with Niagara Files using Rest Services to get, post, and delete resources.
•Developed a Web Service to validate classification markings using the Automated Metadata Tagging Tool (AMTT).
•Integrated the Automated Metadata Tagging Tool into the Error Manager Tool to allow users to promote valid classifications to files written into Trusted Data Format (TDF) files.
•Designed and developed a Data Modeling Tool with a graphical user interface to accept source data and generate models used for back-end analytics. 
•Provided PM DCGS-A’s Tactical Cloud Integration Lab (TCIL) with direct onsite data prep and development support for ingest of 300+ high priority data sources.
•Ensured that applications adhere to security issues reported by Fortify Software.

positions.title: Software Developer/Configuration Manager
positions.description:
• Worked with a team of developers using technologies that include Java, JSP, HTML, Spring, Hibernate, XML, and SQL.
• Responsibilities include software design and development and software testing for specific release dates.
• Responsible for source code audits (CMMI level 3)

positions.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
positions.description:
• Worked with the project team to ensure quality throughout the product lifecycle, including reviewing specifications, developing schedules, and resolving issues
• Created, updated, and executed production ready chains in AppWorx
• Maintained a Microsoft SharePoint site of the project’s progress
• Developed reports detailing the status of the project in relation to the master schedule

positions.title: Residential Networking Consultant
positions.description:
• Provided students with onsite hardware, software, and network troubleshooting on Windows and Macintosh platforms
• Worked as part of a team to design and develop the Residential Networking website used by students to download documentation, software, and FAQs.
• Assisted students with configuring their computers for the University network

positions.title: Parking Lot Manager (summer employee)
positions.description:
• Developed a weekly schedule for parking lot attendants based on current need and peak times
• Resolved customer disputes
• Maintained daily counts and ensured security of parking lot money

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
• Assisted students on a one to one basis with classes in which they were having difficulties
• Tutored Visual Basic, College Algebra, and Urban Development
